name: free-ensures-no-second-proof
source: procedure P(); free ensures false; implementation P() { return; }

name: free-ensures-available-at-call
source: procedure P() returns (x:int); free ensures x == 42; procedure C(); implementation C() { var x:int; call x := P(); assert x == 42; }

name: free-requires-no-call-check
source: procedure P(); free requires false; procedure C(); implementation C() { call P(); }

name: free-requires-callee-assumption
source: procedure P(x:int); free requires x > 0; implementation P(x:int) { assert x > 0; }

name: checked-local-negative
source: procedure P(); free ensures false; implementation P() { assert false; return; }

name: checked-call-negative
source: procedure P(); free requires false; procedure C(); implementation C() { assert false; call P(); }

name: checked-boilerplate-retained
source: procedure P(x:int); free requires true; requires x > 0; procedure C(); implementation C() { call P(0); }

name: free-requires-always-published
source: procedure P(x:int); free requires {:always_assume} x > 0; procedure C(x:int); implementation C(x:int) { call P(x); assert x > 0; }

name: scoped-negative-before-normal-publication
source: procedure P(); free requires {:always_assume} false; procedure C(); implementation C() { if (*) { assert false; assume false; } call P(); }

name: inherited-free-interface-does-not-publish
source: procedure P(); free requires false; procedure C(); implementation C() { free call P(); assert false; }

name: call-publication-invalidated-by-heap-change
source: var g:int; procedure P(); free requires {:always_assume} g > 0; modifies g; ensures g == 0; procedure C(); requires g > 0; modifies g; implementation C() { if (*) { assert g > 0; assume false; } call P(); assert g > 0; }
